name: ship-it
description: Ship a change or coordinate an approved plan through independent issues, adversarial gates, PRs, CI, Copilot review, and merge.

interface.shortDescription: Ship a change or coordinate an approved plan
interface.longDescription: Implements a task description, GitHub issue, or Jira ticket, or coordinates an approved complex plan as an umbrella of independent issues. Each change passes adversarial review, manual testing, CI, and Copilot review before merge. Sail pauses when worker or gate agents are unavailable. Runs only when invoked by name.
defaultPrompt: Use $ship-it to implement and ship this change.
Use $ship-it to coordinate this approved plan as independent issues.
Use $ship-it to ship this GitHub issue.
Use $ship-it to ship this Jira ticket.
